extras: Desktop only. Local-only, Git-friendly. Requires manual installation until available in the community plugin directory.
intentEvidence: A nested whiteboard plugin for Obsidian.
problem: It addresses the difficulty of visually mapping complex relationships between notes, files, and ideas within a standard text-based note-taking environment.
summary: Nestboard is a nested whiteboard plugin that allows users to organize notes, images, and files on infinite, plain-text visual boards saved locally in the vault.
